articles.summary: Project Shield brings together some of the country’s leading sport science institutes, including those at Nike, Stanford Wu Tsai Human Performance Alliance, Emory University and the University of Oregon, to take action on athlete injury reduction, beginning with ACL injuries in female athletes.
articles.title: Nike Announces Project Shield with University Collaborators to Reduce Injury in Female Athletes

articles.summary: All Conditions Gear is inviting outdoor athletes to experience lightweight trail movement with two new shoes designed to help them connect more closely with the terrain: Kigerfly, the brand’s lightest trail-racing shoe ever, and Kiger Hike, a lightweight hiking shoe made for rugged exploration.
articles.title: ACG Kigerfly and Kiger Hike Bring Lightweight Performance to the Trail

articles.summary: The Nike Book 3 is the next evolution of Devin Booker’s signature basketball franchise, built at the intersection of responsive performance and timeless, everyday style.
articles.title: Nike Basketball and Devin Booker Introduce the Nike Book 3, Built for Court Feel and Timeless Style

articles.summary: Nike and the United States Military Academy are unveiling the “Ivy Soldier” uniforms that Army football players will wear to honor the 4th Infantry Division during the 127th Army-Navy Football Game.
articles.title: Nike, Army Honor 4th Infantry Division With ‘Ivy Soldier’ Football Uniforms for 2026 Army-Navy Game

articles.summary: NIKE, Inc. is debuting Tuned Air, the next frontier of Nike Air; new Nike Mind and Nike Free footwear, platforms built to scale across sport; innovation for runners, footballers, trainers, hoopers and outdoor athletes; and new ideas from Nike Sportswear.
articles.title: NIKE, Inc. Unveils the Next Generation of Innovation Across Performance Sports and Sportswear

articles.summary: Nike’s best-in-class suite of midsole foams deliver standout energy return, plush cushioning, staunch stability and critical impact protection. Just as important: With each step, they bring comfort and confidence, no matter the sport or terrain. When creating Nike’s latest footwear innovations, engineers and designers have a toolbox of proprietary options to choose from to design the ideal shoe. Here’s how to understand the benefits of each.
articles.title: Explainer: How Nike’s Innovative Foams Deliver Performance and Comfort

articles.summary: Nike athlete, elite distance runner and New York City Marathon champion Andreas Almgren speaks on using data analytics, unique training tactics and joy to break into the road racing space.
articles.title: How Andreas Almgren Unlocks Champion Results

articles.summary: Brought to life by advanced innovations like the new Nike Mind, Free and Pro, the connected system is changing how Nike Training serves athletes — whether they train as a sport or train for their sport, from the gym to the court, pitch and beyond.
articles.title: Nike Training Introduces Prime, Train, Recover: A Connected System Built Around Athlete Progress

articles.summary: Nike is welcoming Diana Flores, two-time flag football world champion, NFL and International Federation of American Football (IFAF) Global Flag Ambassador, and captain and quarterback of Mexico’s national flag football team, to its roster of athletes.
articles.title: Nike Signs Two-Time World Champion Diana Flores, Growing Its Flag Football Roster

articles.summary: Nike FIT, short for Functional Innovative Technologies, is Nike’s performance-apparel system designed to help eliminate distractions and provide more comfort and freedom to stay in the moment. First introduced in 1991, FIT has evolved through athlete testing, material innovation and sport science research into four distinct technologies that scale across sports: Dri-FIT to help athletes stay dry, Aero-FIT to help them stay cool, Therma-FIT to help them stay warm, and Storm-FIT to help them stay protected.
articles.title: Explainer: What Nike Dri-FIT, Aero-FIT, Therma-FIT and Storm-FIT Actually Do

articles.summary: In innovation, five years is often the difference between cutting edge and obsolete. Nike Air is going on 50. That’s because the people here are as restless as any great athlete, never satisfied with the latest win, always pushing for more. With the new Tuned Air era, those gains may be endless.
articles.title: Nike Air Has Scaled Across Sports for Decades. Its Next Era Is Infinite.

articles.summary: Nike Basketball is reimagining Flight, Force and Uptempo as three distinct performance builds shaped around how athletes move, play, and want their footwear to look and feel.
articles.title: Nike Basketball Reintroduces Flight, Force and Uptempo, a New Foundation for the Modern Game

articles.summary: Nike is introducing four new Nike Mind footwear models: the Nike Mind Sock, Nike Mind Moc Flyknit, Nike Mind Slip and Nike Mind Sneaker. Together with the Nike Mind 001, the new styles give athletes a range of choice in both sensation and style.
articles.title: The Expanded Nike Mind Platform Gives Athletes More Choice in Sensation

articles.summary: Nike and Michigan State University are announcing an eight-year extension of their all-sports partnership, building on more than a quarter century of shared history in East Lansing and beyond.
articles.title: Nike and Michigan State Announce Eight-Year Extension of Longtime Partnership

articles.summary: Project Ride, Nike Morpho X and the Nike Therma-FIT A.I.R. Jacket are part of broader effort to reshape the Nike Sportswear portfolio around greater newness, distinction and more meaningful choice, giving everyday athletes more ways to make Nike their own.
articles.title: Introducing the Future of Nike Sportswear: An Innovation Pipeline Built for What’s Next

articles.summary: The NikeSKIMS Waffle Racer carries forward the iconic waffle traction pattern and low-profile racing shape of the original Nike Waffle Racer, joined by the NikeSKIMS Retro Sport collection of timeless sport styles.
articles.title: The NikeSKIMS Waffle Racer and Retro Sport Collection Reimagine Classic Sport Style

articles.summary: It started with a simple question: Why were some of the world's best runners training barefoot? The answer would change the way Nike thought about footwear, and continues to shape its innovation 20 years later.
articles.title: The History of Nike Free: How Sports Science Helped Fuel the Barefoot Revolution

articles.summary: NIKE, Inc. is introducing Full Stride Ahead, its strategy to get closer to athletes and focus resources on the greatest opportunities for long-term growth, during its 2026 Investor Day at the Philip H. Knight Campus in Beaverton, Oregon. NIKE is also outlining its 2031 financial framework.
articles.title: NIKE, Inc. Announces Full Stride Ahead Strategy and 2031 Financial Framework at Investor Day

articles.summary: Nike and Kids Of Immigrants continue to celebrate football as a universal language, connecting cultures and generations in a new footwear collaboration that brings the global communities of both brands together through the beautiful game.
articles.title: Nike and Kids Of Immigrants Return With a New Footwear Collection for the Football Pitch and Streets

articles.summary: Nike’s race-day system of speed includes Apex, Alphafly 4 and Swooshfly. Each shoe serves a distinct purpose, creating a lineup of complementary innovations that make race day feel more possible, personal and powerful.
articles.title: Nike Debuts a Race-Day System of Speed Designed for Every Runner

articles.summary: Nike Running is unveiling two new footwear models built to fuel the runner journey: Vomero 19, a maximum cushioned daily trainer designed for everyday miles and the moments in between, and Nike Vaporfly 5, engineered for pinnacle race-day performance.
articles.title: Nike Vomero 19 and Vaporfly 5 Deliver Innovation for Everyday Miles and Race-Day Performance

articles.summary: The newly signed Nike athlete reflects on perseverance, leadership and the lessons that have shaped her journey from a young girl fighting for a place on the field to one of the sport’s most recognizable stars.
articles.title: Diana Flores Is Opening Doors for a New Generation of Women Flag Footballers

articles.summary: NIKE, Inc. is introducing a breakthrough method of make that’s changing how the company creates Air, building on a legacy of athlete-centered innovation to provide unprecedented control over how Air looks, feels and performs.
articles.title: Nike Tuned Air Unlocks a New Era of Precision Cushioning for Athletes Across Sports

articles.summary: Nike has extended its partnership with Oregon State University through 2031 and added Beavers athletes Braden Atkinson and Jesse Legree to its Blue Ribbon Elite NIL roster.
articles.title: Nike Extends Long-Term Partnership With Oregon State and Signs Two Blue Ribbon Elite NIL Athletes

articles.summary: United by a relentless drive to push boundaries, Nike and Formula 1 will bring new energy to the pinnacle of motorsport through product, innovations and race-weekend experiences designed to inspire the next generation of athletes and fans.
articles.title: Nike and Formula 1 Join Forces in Long-Term Global Partnership

articles.summary: For 16 years, Nike Gyakusou has brought a new design language to performance running, pairing Nike innovation with Jun Takahashi’s perspective as both a designer and runner. Now, with its first collection since 2021, Gyakusou is building on that very foundation, bringing forward new ideas in performance, function and design.
articles.title: Nike Gyakusou Returns to Challenge What Performance Running Looks Like Next
